requiredScenarios.threat: A different module attempts to reuse this module's origin.
requiredScenarios.expected: Different stable module IDs map to different exact HTTPS origins.

requiredScenarios.threat: A message arrives from a lookalike or attacker-controlled origin.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject unless sourceOrigin exactly equals the active module origin.

requiredScenarios.threat: An iframe sends a message through the injected bridge object.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject messages when isMainFrame is false; subframes are blocked by policy.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module sends an API request before bridge initialization.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject all API messages until a valid hello/helloAck handshake completes.

requiredScenarios.threat: A delayed message from a previous document or WebView session arrives.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject when sessionId does not match the active Host-generated session ID.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module sends malformed JSON, duplicate keys, or an invalid Platform API envelope.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject before dispatch; do not partially process the message.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module sends an oversized UTF-8 message.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject before JSON parsing when encoded size exceeds 65536 bytes.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module sends a response or event as if it were a Host message.
requiredScenarios.expected: Accept only Platform API request envelopes from module to Host.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module includes a different module ID in request metadata or parameters.
requiredScenarios.expected: Reject unknown fields; attribute requests only from Host-owned session context.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module attempts to name or address another module's storage namespace.
requiredScenarios.expected: Derive the namespace from the active session module ID; no API accepts a caller-selected namespace.

requiredScenarios.threat: Untrusted content attempts to invoke a generic native JavaScript interface.
The installed WebView lacks WEB_MESSAGE_LISTENER support.
requiredScenarios.expected: Refuse module launch; do not fall back to an unrestricted transport.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module attempts top-level navigation to another origin or custom scheme.
requiredScenarios.expected: Block navigation in the module WebView and do not dispatch external intents.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module attempts to read local files or ContentProvider URIs.
requiredScenarios.expected: File and content access settings remain disabled.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module attempts to load remote executable scripts or remote connections.
requiredScenarios.expected: CSP permits same-origin scripts only and connect-src self only.

requiredScenarios.threat: Module calls an API after consent is revoked or capability support disappears.
requiredScenarios.expected: Re-evaluate method, manifest declaration, Host support, and current consent on every call.

requiredScenarios.threat: Navigation, renderer death, update, disablement, or removal leaves old callbacks active.
requiredScenarios.expected: Invalidate the session, cancel pending work, and discard late responses/events.
